what_this_is: An exact, whole-population measurement of the RRP-015 control delta. Computed in float64 from the frozen source and the consolidated FP32 trained tensors. No model was run and no checkpoint was modified.
analysis_dtype: float64 accumulation; float32 inputs to svdvals

delta_over_whole_model.definition: ||delta||_F / ||theta_supa||_F with delta zero on untrained tensors, denominator over ALL 310 tensors

spectrum_population.note: The RANK-001 prereg tabulated FIVE named tensors and described the range as 'effective rank 16-72, 16 directions carry 59-88% of the energy'. These are the same statistics over ALL 2D trained matrices.
